decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8279. Series context: trend strength 0.866 and seasonal strength 0.115; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.158); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 2.042.
